auth.at_rest: sha256 hash only; plaintext keys never stored or logged

backtest_bounds.rejections: 422 (locked error envelope) for over-bounds params; 429 for queue-full

cors.preflight: OPTIONS returns 204/200 with allow headers; no credentials at Phase-2

states.unproven: n_scored_events >= N_MIN (8) but no recorded PASS G1 re-run verdict

endpoint_policy.data_handlers: sync def (anyio threadpool) — blocking DB work never on the event loop
endpoint_policy.note: pure-async (psycopg v3 / asyncpg) is a documented alternative, not Phase-2

engines.enforcement: T1 exit — CI permission test: read-only role rejects a write (42501); no GET path uses write_engine
engines.provisioning: readonly role + app role provisioned as a T1 dependency (before the CI permission test)

error_envelope.rule: no route ever leaks the framework default shape (422, HTTPException, and 500 all map to the envelope)

freshness.empty_is_404: GET /v1/signals/{instrument} with no rows returns 404, never an empty 200 body
freshness.rule: no cycle today is a visible stale state with last-known data — never a fabricated fresh value

gate: G1 re-run verdict or explicit infra-first decision (recorded in WS3_PROGRESS.md)

notify.listener: dedicated LISTEN connection in a background thread -> asyncio.Queue -> fan-out; reconnect with backoff
notify.mechanism: Postgres NOTIFY issued by the orchestrator immediately after all ledger writes for the cycle have committed
notify.no_shared_memory: uvicorn and the orchestrator are separate OS processes; the DB is the bus
notify.t4_prerequisite: wire the post-commit NOTIFY into run_ws2_t3_orchestrate.py in T4 (prose-only in this contract)
notify.transaction_safety: NOTIFY runs post-commit — a cycle that fails or rolls back never pushes

rate_limits.deployment: single-worker only (uvicorn --workers 1); multi-worker is a WS-5/Redis goal

GET /v1/forecasts/{instrument}.status: 501 not_implemented until WS-2 stores forecast rows (no forecasts table in the store today)

GET /v1/instruments.purpose: distinct instruments with latest signal + freshness

response.worker_last_run: ISO8601|null (from metrics worker.last_run when present, else latest cycle publication_ts)

WS /v1/stream/signals.purpose: push each new signal batch on cycle_complete

sdk.layout: pakhi.client subpackage inside this repo (from pakhi.client import PakhiClient)
sdk.transport: thin, typed, httpx-based; docstrings link to OpenAPI

versioning.policy: breaking schema changes bump the major version

websocket.history_fallback: missed subscribers covered by GET /v1/signals history — NOTIFY is a wake-up, not the source of truth
